summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: Package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex `_0xNNNN` identifiers, literal-alias objects) and, at `npm install` time, downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmod+x's it, then invokes it via execFileSync against sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB file prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing an obfuscator.io-shape hex string array and a shift-based unpacker (WV8StW), whose behavior cannot be inspected as shipped. The package is advertised as a CircleCI orb aggregator for frontend CI commands, a purpose that does not require shipping a Bun runtime or executing a large obfuscated bundle at install time. The alternate-runtime path (Node lifecycle script pulling an alien runtime to execute a sibling bundle) evades Node-only inspection tooling, and the payload runs unconditionally on default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
